SELECT 
    c.c_last_name, 
    c.c_first_name, 
    c.c_salutation, 
    c.c_preferred_cust_flag, 
    dj.ss_ticket_number, 
    dj.cnt 
FROM 
    (SELECT 
         ss_ticket_number, 
         ss_customer_sk, 
         COUNT(*) AS cnt 
     FROM 
         store_sales 
         JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND d_year IN (2000, 2001, 2002)) AS dd ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk 
         JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk 
         JOIN (SELECT hd_demo_sk, hd_buy_potential, hd_dep_count, hd_vehicle_count FROM household_demographics WHERE hd_buy_potential IN ('1001-5000', '5001-10000') AND hd_vehicle_count > 0 AND hd_dep_count > hd_vehicle_count) AS hd ON store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk 
     WHERE 
         store.s_county = 'Williamson County' 
     GROUP BY 
         ss_ticket_number, 
         ss_customer_sk 
     HAVING 
         cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 5) dj 
    JOIN customer c ON dj.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk 
ORDER BY 
    dj.cnt DESC, 
    c.c_last_name ASC
